name: Guangxi Huaxi Nonferrous Metal Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangxi Huaxi Nonferrous Metal Co.,Ltd engages in the exploration, mining, beneficiation, and engineering supervision of non-ferrous metals in China. It offers tin, zinc, lead, and antimony concentrates, as well as tin ingots, zinc ingots, and steel ingots. The company was formerly known as Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. Guangxi Huaxi Nonferrous Metal Co.,Ltd was founded in 1952 and is based in Nanning, China.
